planning_notes: Board fixed to arduino:avr:uno; wiring preserved: DHT11 data=D7, HC-SR04 TRIG=D8/ECHO=D9, TM1637 CLK=D4/DIO=D5, passive buzzer=D6.

Control period set to 10ms to match the previous contract; all time-dependent behavior (sampling cadence, page switching tolerances, alarm phase/cadence, and serial reporting timing windows) remains in the SysML model using elapsed_ms.
Serial baud uses 115200 per the alarm reporting specification stated in the original requirements; framing assumed as line_or_idle with idle timeout handled by the serial subsystem.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: DHT11 temperature measurement (for display integer and ALARM_TEMP check)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: DHT11 humidity measurement (not used for alarm per provided requirements, but acquired for completeness)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Validity flag for DHT11 shared reading (temperature/humidity coherence)

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: HC-SR04 distance in centimeters (for display integer and ALARM_DISTANCE check)

interfaces.name: io_4
interfaces.meaning: Validity flag for HC-SR04 distance (out-of-range/timeout sets false and retains previous distance)

interfaces.name: io_5
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 four-digit number display (model selects which page/value to show; invalid selected measurement blanks display)

interfaces.name: io_6
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer tone request (model controls 1000Hz intermittent alarm at 500ms on / 500ms off with phase continuity)

interfaces.name: io_7
interfaces.meaning: Actual delta time since previous control step (used by model for sampling cadence, display alternation, alarm cadence, and deadlines)

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Serial reporting gate: report alarm start, reason changes within 200ms, and every 1000ms while alarm is continuously active

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_0
interfaces.meaning: ALARM_TEMP currently active (temperature valid and strictly > 32C)

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_1
interfaces.meaning: ALARM_DISTANCE currently active (distance valid and strictly < 15cm)

configuration_resolution.original_requirement:
设计一个智能环境监测与报警系统，使用 DHT11 温湿度传感器（数据引脚 D7）、HC-SR04 超声波模块（Trig=D8，Echo=D9）、TM1637 数码管（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和蜂鸣器（D6）。默认每 2 秒轮流显示温度和距离；当温度高于 32℃ 或距离小于 15cm 时，蜂鸣器间歇报警，并通过串口输出报警原因。
验收约定：目标Uno，DHT11数据D7，HC-SR04 TRIG=D8/ECHO=D9，TM1637 CLK=D4/DIO=D5，无源蜂鸣器D6。DHT采样开始间隔2000..2200ms；距离采样开始间隔60..180ms，回波等待必须有25000us超时，有效范围2..400cm，距离=回波微秒/58。温度默认先显示，之后每2000ms交替显示温度和距离，显示整数且量化容差1，页面切换容差150ms；所选测量无效时空白，初始温度无效须空白。每次新读数到输出的响应容差200ms，DHT缓存期间保留最近读数；失败必须标为无效，不能阻塞其他设备或模型计时。仅有效温度严格>32℃或有效距离严格<15cm触发报警，先比较原始测量再取显示整数；任一原因成立立即开始1000Hz鸣叫，500ms响/500ms静，完整周期1000ms，边沿容差100ms；所有原因消失后200ms内静音。持续报警时原因变化不重启蜂鸣相位。串口115200：报警开始、原因变化后200ms内，以及持续报警每1000ms（容差200ms）报告所有当前成立原因。温度原因包含ALARM_TEMP，距离原因包含ALARM_DISTANCE，可同行或分行；不得报告不成立原因，其余状态文本不限。首次采样200ms内开始；设备故障恢复后继续真实测量。以上补充约定对各组相同。
